title: Unplug, don't just switch off
body: Devices on standby still draw power. Unplug chargers and electronics when not in use.

title: Fix that drip
body: A single leaking tap can waste over 10,000 litres of water a year.

title: Compost your food scraps
body: Composting keeps organic waste out of landfills and cuts methane emissions.

title: Batch your errands
body: Combine multiple trips into one to cut down on fuel use and emissions.

title: Let natural light in
body: Open curtains during the day instead of relying on artificial lighting.

title: Say no to single-use plastic
body: Carry a reusable bag, bottle, and cutlery set to avoid disposable plastic.

title: Collect rainwater
body: Use a rain barrel to water plants instead of using treated tap water.

title: Plant native species
body: Native plants need less water and support local pollinators better than exotic ones.
